description: Change the PHP execution mode for the virtual server 'greenleaf.test' to FPM (FastCGI Process Manager) and configure the FPM pool settings. Specifically, set the maximum number of child processes (pm.max_children) to 5. You can find these settings under Server Configuration > Website Options (for the mode) and Server Configuration > PHP-FPM Configuration (for the pool settings). Ensure the configuration is saved and applied.
